text:
Marco Diaz: Passing Cornerstone (merchant onboarding) to CS — signed ELA yesterday, expected start next week. High-level: SSO (SAML), private VPC + dedicated capacity for bursty batch scoring (~200 req/s), embeddings dataset ~1.2M rows. Pilot 6 weeks. Renewal: 12-mo contract but PO is queued; risk if onboarding slips. Main contacts: Sarah Lopez (IT, sarah@cornerstone.com), Dev lead Tom Bianchi. Security review ETA ~2w.
Olivia Chen: Thanks Marco — I will own program lead. @Priya Nair, can you own SSO + infra triage? I'll schedule a kickoff with Cornerstone + Sales.
Priya Nair: On it. Need network contact, firewall rules, and whether KMS/HSM required. @Evan Brooks can you run a dedicated capacity + cost estimate? Also any model preference or PII concerns?
Evan Brooks: Quick estimate: start with 2x A10G nodes + 1x burst pool (auto-scale) — ballpark cost I'll confirm in 48h. Model plan: initial ranking on Llama-2.1-large then quantized 7B for prod latency. PII note: data contains user IDs and invoices — will need DPA & data flow diagram.
Jamal Reed: I'll put together the onboarding runbook and collect a prompt set for quality gating. Also recommend enabling prefix/KV caching and sample evals during pilot.
Olivia Chen: Action items: 1) Olivia — schedule kickoff w/Cornerstone & Sales (owner: Olivia, due +3d). 2) Priya — SSO & VPC checklist + infra blockers (owner: Priya, due +5d). 3) Evan — capacity + cost + model recs (owner: Evan, due +2d). 4) Jamal — runbook & eval prompt set (owner: Jamal, due +5d). 5) Marco — share contact list & signed ELA (owner: Marco, ASAP).
Marco Diaz: Sending ELA & contacts now. Finance flagged PO delay, I'll escalate.
Priya Nair: Quick Q for Marco — do they require customer-managed KMS in the VPC or are we okay with our managed keys? Any compliance notes?
Marco Diaz: They prefer KMS integration. SOC2 is fine, FedRAMP not required. Sarah will return the security questionnaire by end of week.
reminder-bot: Reminder: kickoff meeting scheduled in 3 days. Attendees: Olivia Chen, Marco Diaz, Sarah Lopez, Priya Nair, Evan Brooks, Jamal Reed.
Olivia Chen: :thumbsup: I'll prepare an agenda — SSO checklist, VPC/network diagram, pilot metrics & success criteria, runbook ownership, escalation path.
Jamal Reed: Also calling out renewal risk — PO timeline could delay go-live revenue. Recommend weekly status updates to Sales lead + Finance until PO clears.
Marco Diaz: Agree. I'll follow up with finance today and ping Sarah for questionnaire.
Olivia Chen: All good. I'll post meeting invite and agenda after I sync with Marco. Thanks team.
